metadata.objective_formulation: maximise cumulative throughput minus penalised stockyard overflow; a strict no-overflow variant fixes overflow to zero
metadata.occasion_description: A reclaimer maintenance job must occur during sustained strong demand on days 33-46. It can use a short full shutdown, a longer 30%-available mode, or the longest 70%-available mode.
metadata.expected_model_value: Select the maintenance mode that provides the best trade-off between maintenance duration, retained capacity, and throughput.

design_evidence.purpose: Construction check only. The reference schedule is a known witness, not an optimal solution. Final claims must compare the solver result against the manual baseline.

model_notation.K: maintenance modes F, P30 and P70
